DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族への連絡はつきましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Were you able to contact your family?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。電話を使わせていただき、ありがとうございました。迎えに来てもらえます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 借りた電話で家族へ連絡でき迎えが来ると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Thank you for letting me use the telephone. They can come and pick me up.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you reached your family using the borrowed telephone and that they will come to pick you up. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どちらで待ち合わせることになりましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Where did you agree to meet?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 交番の前と伝えましたが、家族は別の交番だと思っていたようです。もう一度場所を説明してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 家族が交番を取り違えたため再説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: I told them in front of the police box, but it seems they thought I meant a different police box. May I explain the location again?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask to explain the location again because your family confused one police box with another. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まだ通話中でしたら、そのままお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you are still on the line, please go ahead and tell them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: はい。今いる交番の名前を、入口の表示で確かめて読み上げます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 入口表示の交番名を読んで家族に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Yes. I will check the name of this police box on the sign at the entrance and read it out.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Read the police box name on the entrance sign to your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 迎えの方に分かるか、聞いてみてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please ask whether the person picking you up knows where that is.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 名前を伝えたら分かったそうです。家族は車で来ます。私は歩き出さず、ここで待つと話しました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 家族に場所が伝わり自分は動かず待つと報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Once I told them the name, they said they knew it. My family is coming by car. I told them I would stay here and wait, without setting off on foot.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Report that your family knows the location and that you will stay where you are and wait. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 分かりました。電話はお済みになったらお戻しください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Understood. Please return the telephone when you have finished your call.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 通話を終えました。こちらにお返しします。自分の携帯の電池が切れていたので、とても助かりました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 通話を終えて電話を返し携帯の電池切れを説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have finished the call. Here is your telephone back. My own phone's battery had died, so this was a great help.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Return the telephone after finishing your call and explain that your mobile phone's battery was dead. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どういたしまして。ご家族に会えましたら、気をつけてお帰りください。失礼します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: You're welcome. Once you meet your family, have a safe journey home. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらの料金をお預かりします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: I will take your payment here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: すみません。千円札を出したつもりでしたが、五千円札でした。今の金額を確かめてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 千円のつもりで出した五千円札の確認を頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: Excuse me. I meant to give you a 1,000-yen note, but it was a 5,000-yen note. Could you check the amount I just gave you?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask for confirmation of the 5,000-yen note you handed over thinking it was 1,000 yen. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 五千円をお預かりしています。料金を引いて、お釣りをお返しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: I have received 5,000 yen. I will deduct the charge and return your change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。財布から続けて百円玉も出しかけましたが、それはまだ手元にあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 追加硬貨はまだ手元にあると明らかにする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: Thank you. I also started taking a 100-yen coin out of my wallet, but I still have it in my hand.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Make clear that the additional coin is still in your hand. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 硬貨は追加されなくて大丈夫です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: There is no need to add the coin.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。百円玉は財布へ戻します。お預けしたのは五千円札一枚ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 硬貨を戻し預けたのは五千円札一枚と確かめる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I will put the 100-yen coin back in my wallet. What I gave you was one 5,000-yen note, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Put the coin back and confirm that you handed over one 5,000-yen note. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。こちらが領収書とお釣りです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. Here are your receipt and change.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 受け取りました。領収書は封筒の料金として、家計の記録に残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 領収書を郵送料の家計記録に残すと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: I have received them. I will keep the receipt in my household accounts as the charge for mailing the envelope.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will keep the receipt in your household records for postage. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お釣りも、その場でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please check your change here as well.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 確認できました。急いで財布へ入れず、受け取った額を見てからしまいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 釣銭をその場で確認してから財布へしまうと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: I have checked it. I will look at the amount I received before putting it away, instead of rushing to put it in my wallet.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will check the change on the spot before putting it in your wallet. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お確かめいただき、ありがとうございました。それでは、お気をつけてお帰りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for checking. Have a safe journey home.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お引き出しについてのご相談ですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-01.translation: You would like to ask about a withdrawal, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 三万円を引き出したいです。そのうち五千円分は、千円札で受け取れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 三万円のうち五千円分を千円札で受け取りたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-02.translation: I would like to withdraw 30,000 yen. Could I receive 5,000 yen of that in 1,000-yen notes?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to receive 5,000 yen of a 30,000-yen withdrawal in 1,000-yen notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: ご希望の内訳を、もう一度教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me your preferred breakdown again.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一万円札二枚、五千円札一枚、千円札五枚です。家賃の分と、手元で使う分を分けたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 万円札二枚五千円札一枚千円札五枚の内訳を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-04.translation: Two 10,000-yen notes, one 5,000-yen note, and five 1,000-yen notes. I want to separate the money for rent from the money for everyday use.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the breakdown: two 10,000-yen notes, one 5,000-yen note, and five 1,000-yen notes. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 窓口でその内訳に対応できるか、確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will check whether the counter can provide that breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。千円札を五枚と言いましたが、追加の五千円ではなく、三万円の中の五千円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 千円札五枚は総額への追加ではないと明確にする。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I said five 1,000-yen notes, but that is 5,000 yen within the 30,000 yen, not an additional 5,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Clarify that the five 1,000-yen notes are not in addition to the total. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 合計は三万円ということですね。枚数を記した紙でも確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-07.translation: So the total is 30,000 yen. Let's also check on a piece of paper listing the number of notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この紙に書きます。一万円二枚で二万円、五千円一枚と千円五枚で一万円、合わせて三万円です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 金種別の金額を計算し合計三万円と紙に書く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-08.translation: I will write it on this paper. Two 10,000-yen notes make 20,000 yen; one 5,000-yen note and five 1,000-yen notes make 10,000 yen, for a total of 30,000 yen.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Calculate the amounts by denomination and write the total of 30,000 yen on paper. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お手続きと費用をご案内してから、ご希望の内訳で受け取れるかお伝えします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-09.translation: After explaining the procedure and costs, I will tell you whether you can receive your preferred breakdown.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今日できる方法を聞いてから進めます。受け取る時も、紙の枚数と現金を照らして数えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 取扱費用を聞いて進め受領時も紙と枚数を照合すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I will hear what options are available today before proceeding. When I receive the money, I will also count the cash against the number of notes on the paper.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will hear the handling costs before proceeding and compare the number of notes with the paper when receiving them. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: それでは、こちらの紙と合わせて確認いたします。ご相談ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-06-001-SHARED-11.translation: Then I will check this together with your paper. Thank you for consulting us.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 箱入りの商品と、一本ずつの商品をご覧でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you looking at the boxed products and the ones sold individually?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。箱で買うつもりでしたが、今日は歩いて来たので、持てる重さか迷っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 徒歩のため箱入り飲料の重さを心配していると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I planned to buy a box, but I walked here today, so I am unsure whether I can carry the weight.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that you are concerned about the weight of a box of drinks because you came on foot. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 箱には十二本入っています。一本ずつの商品も隣にございます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-03.translation: There are twelve bottles in a box. The individually sold ones are next to them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 一本の大きさは同じですね。帰り道に坂があるので、今日は三本だけにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 坂道を考えて同サイズのばら売り三本を選ぶ。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-04.translation: Each bottle is the same size, isn't it? There is a hill on my way home, so I will take just three today.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Choose three individually sold bottles of the same size, considering the hill. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 三本でしたら、こちらからお取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-05.translation: If you want three, please take them from here.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。箱を開けずに、ばら売りの列から取ります。残りは別の日に買いに来ます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 箱を開けず別売の列から取り残りは後日買うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-06.translation: Thank you. I will take them from the individually sold row without opening a box. I will come back another day to buy the rest.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will take them from the individual-sale row without opening a box and buy the rest another day. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 持参した袋は底が薄いので、三本を入れて持てるか心配です。丈夫な袋もありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 持参袋の耐荷重を心配し丈夫な袋の選択肢を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-08.translation: The bag I brought has a thin bottom, so I am worried about carrying three bottles in it. Do you have sturdy bags too?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Express concern about the weight your own bag can hold and ask about a sturdier bag option. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: こちらの袋も選べます。ただ、まず無理なく持てる本数にしてください。会計前に重さをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-09.translation: You can choose this bag too. However, first choose a number of bottles you can comfortably carry. Please check the weight before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。重すぎたら一本減らして二本にします。買ってから持てないと困るので、会計前に確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 会計前に重さを試し必要なら二本に減らすと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. If they are too heavy, I will take one out and buy two. It would be a problem if I couldn't carry them after buying them, so I will check before paying.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will test the weight before paying and reduce the number to two if necessary. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご無理のない量をお選びください。ご来店ありがとうございました。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-07-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please choose an amount you can comfortably manage. Thank you for visiting.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 落ち葉についてのお尋ねでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about fallen leaves?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。子どもと葉っぱを使って絵を作りたいです。地面に落ちているものを、数枚持ち帰ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子どもの工作用に落ち葉を数枚持ち帰りたいと尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. I want to make a picture using leaves with my child. May we take home a few that have fallen on the ground?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask to take home a few fallen leaves for your child's craft activity. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: こちらの区画では、落ちている葉を少量拾ってお使いいただけます。枝についている葉は取らないでください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-03.translation: In this area, you may pick up a small amount of fallen leaves to use. Please do not take leaves still on branches.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。赤い葉が枝にもありますが、それは残します。落ちた葉だけ子どもと探します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 枝についた赤い葉は残し落ちた葉のみ探すと答える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. There are red leaves on the branches too, but we will leave those. My child and I will look only for fallen leaves.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Answer that you will leave the red leaves on the branches and look only for fallen ones. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 清掃用にまとめた葉の山は、崩さずそのままにしておいてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please leave the piles of leaves gathered for cleaning intact, without disturbing them.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: あの山から選ぼうと思っていました。散らばっている葉を五枚ほど拾うことにします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 清掃の山を崩さず散在する葉を五枚拾うと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-06.translation: I was thinking of choosing from that pile. We will pick up about five scattered leaves instead.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will leave the cleaning pile undisturbed and pick up five scattered leaves. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 拾う際に、植え込みへ入り込まないようお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please do not go into the planted areas when picking them up.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 通路のそばで見つけます。同じ形を五枚そろえるつもりでしたが、見つかった形で作品を考えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 植込みへ入らず見つけた葉の形で作品を考えると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-08.translation: We will find them beside the path. I planned to collect five of the same shape, but we will decide on our artwork based on the shapes we find.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will stay out of the planted areas and plan your artwork around the shapes of leaves you find. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 拾い終えた後、袋に入れて持ち帰れますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-09.translation: Can you put them in a bag to take home once you have finished collecting them?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい、小さな袋を持っています。子どもが手に持ったまま走ると飛んでしまうので、私が袋を持ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 葉を袋へ入れ親が持って飛散を防ぐと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes, I have a small bag. They would blow away if my child ran while holding them, so I will carry the bag.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Explain that you will put the leaves in a bag and the parent will carry it to prevent them from scattering. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 素敵な作品ができるといいですね。それでは、お子様と楽しくお過ごしください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21219-08-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you make a lovely picture. Enjoy your time with your child.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お連れ様との待ち合わせでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you meeting someone you are traveling with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。でも、友達から来られないと連絡がありました。一人で先に出発したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 友人欠席の連絡を受け一人で出発したいと申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. But my friend contacted me to say they cannot come. I would like to set off ahead on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that your friend has told you they cannot come and that you want to set off alone. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お手元の切符は、ご自身の分だけでしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-03.translation: Do you have only your own ticket with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 私の一枚だけです。友達は自分で買う予定だったので、私の切符には変更がありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 切符は自分一枚で友人の切符変更はないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-04.translation: Just my one ticket. My friend was going to buy their own, so there is no change to my ticket.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that you have only your own ticket and there is no friend's ticket to change. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: では、乗る列車を確認しましょう。何時ごろまでに着きたいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-05.translation: Then let's check which train to take. By about what time would you like to arrive?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 夕方の約束に間に合わせたいです。二人で行くときは途中で食事をする予定でしたが、今日は寄らずに行きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 食事の寄り道をやめ夕方の約束までに着きたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-06.translation: I want to be in time for an evening appointment. When we were going together, we planned to stop for a meal along the way, but today I will go without stopping.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say that you will skip the meal stop and want to arrive in time for your evening appointment. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 行き先を確認して、乗り換えの案内をお渡しします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-07.translation: I will check your destination and give you transfer directions.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。待ち合わせの場所を友達に送ったままなので、もう待っていないことも連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: もう待っていない旨を友人に連絡すると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I already sent my friend the meeting place, so I will also let them know I am no longer waiting.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will tell your friend you are no longer waiting. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ご案内した列車に乗るなら、そろそろホームへ移動する時間です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-09.translation: If you are taking the train I suggested, it is about time to move to the platform.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: では、連絡を済ませてからホームに行きます。一人でも乗り換えを迷わないよう、この案内を持っていきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 連絡後に案内を携帯してホームへ向かうと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-10.translation: Then I will contact my friend before going to the platform. I will take these directions so I don't get confused about transfers on my own.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will contact your friend, then take the directions with you to the platform. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご友人にはまた別の日に会えるとよいですね。それでは、お気をつけていってらっしゃいませ。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-01-001-SHARED-11.translation: I hope you can see your friend another day. Have a safe journey.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 広報紙についてのお問い合わせですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you inquiring about the community newsletter?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 家に届いた紙の折り目が破れて、催しの見出しが読めません。記事の続きを読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 折り目の破損で催し見出しが読めないと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-02.translation: The fold in the copy delivered to my home is torn, and I cannot read the event headline. I want to read the rest of the article.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain that damage along the fold makes the event headline unreadable. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 何ページの記事でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which page is the article on?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 最後から二ページ目です。写真は見えますが、何の催しか分からなくて、予定に書けずにいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 記事のページと写真が見える状態を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-04.translation: The second-to-last page. I can see the photo, but I don't know what the event is, so I haven't been able to put it in my schedule.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Give the article's page and explain that you can see the photograph. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 同じ号を探します。発行月は分かりますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-05.translation: I will look for the same issue. Do you know its publication month?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 表紙に今月の日付があります。紙を持ってきたので、こちらを見ていただけますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 発行月と持参した広報紙を示す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-06.translation: The cover has this month's date. I brought the paper with me; could you look at it?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Indicate the publication month and show the newsletter you brought. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この号ですね。窓口に予備があるか確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-07.translation: This issue, then. I will check whether we have a spare at the counter.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 一部いただけると助かります。なければ、そのページを読める場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 予備一部又は閲覧できる場所を希望する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-08.translation: It would help if I could have a copy. If there are none, please tell me somewhere I can read that page.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask for a spare copy or a place where you can read it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 予備がありました。ここで、破れていた記事と同じかお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-09.translation: We had a spare. Please check here that it is the same article as the torn one.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 同じ写真なので、この記事です。見出しから読めます。持ち帰って家族と参加するか相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 同一記事を確認し家族と参加を相談すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-10.translation: It has the same photo, so this is the article. I can read it from the headline. I will take it home and discuss with my family whether to participate.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Confirm it is the same article and say you will discuss participation with your family. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お役に立ててよかったです。それでは、この一部をお持ちください。失礼いたします。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-02-001-SHARED-11.translation: I'm glad I could help. Please take this copy. Goodbye.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 問診票で、お困りのところはありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is there anything on the medical questionnaire you need help with?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 日本語の会話は少しできますが、この小さい文字が読みづらいです。読めない欄を聞いてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 小さい文字を読みにくく欄の説明を求める。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-02.translation: I can speak a little Japanese, but these small letters are hard to read. May I ask about the fields I cannot read?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say that the small lettering is hard to read and ask for explanations of the fields. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: どの欄から確認しましょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-03.translation: Which field shall we check first?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この三つの見出しです。順に読んでいただければ、自分で答えを書けると思います。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 三つの見出しを順に読んでほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-04.translation: These three headings. If you read them in order, I think I can write the answers myself.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Ask for the three headings to be read in order. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: まず、普段飲んでいる薬についての欄です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-05.translation: First is the field about medicines you usually take.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 薬の名前を覚えていません。持ってきた手帳に書いてあるので、見ながら書きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 薬名を手帳で確認して書きたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-06.translation: I don't remember the medicines' names. They are written in the booklet I brought, so I would like to refer to it while writing.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you want to check the medicine names in your booklet and write them down. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 次の二つは、これまでの病気と、アレルギーについてです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-07.translation: The next two are about past illnesses and allergies.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 言葉が分かりました。病気については書けますが、アレルギーの欄はどこまで書けばよいか、担当の方に聞きたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アレルギー欄の記入範囲を担当に質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-08.translation: I understand the words now. I can write about illnesses, but I would like to ask the staff member in charge how much to include in the allergy field.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask the staff member in charge how much information to put in the allergy field. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その質問は担当へお伝えします。書けた欄は、ご自身でお確かめください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-09.translation: I will pass that question to the staff member in charge. Please check the fields you have completed yourself.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。手帳を見て薬の欄を書きました。聞きたい欄は空けてあります。説明を聞いてから仕上げたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 書けた欄と未記入欄を示し説明後に仕上げたいと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I filled in the medicine field using my booklet. I have left the field I want to ask about blank. I would like to finish after hearing the explanation.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Indicate the completed and blank fields and say you want to finish after the explanation. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 担当へおつなぎします。それでは、用紙と手帳をお持ちになってお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-03-001-SHARED-11.translation: I will put you in touch with the staff member in charge. Please wait with the form and booklet.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 掲示してあるお知らせについてですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this about the posted notice?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。日本語教室で、この防犯のお知らせを読むことになりました。分からない言葉があるので、質問したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 防犯掲示を日本語教室で読むため語句を質問する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. We are going to read this crime prevention notice in Japanese class. There are words I don't understand, so I would like to ask about them.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about vocabulary so you can read the crime prevention notice in Japanese class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 気になった言葉を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please tell me which expression you were wondering about.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 「声をかけ合う」のところです。知らない人を見つけたら、私たちが追いかけて名前を聞く、という意味でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 声をかけ合うが追跡して名前を聞く意味か確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-04.translation: The part about calling out to one another. Does it mean that if we see a stranger, we should chase them and ask their name?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check whether calling out to one another means pursuing someone and asking their name. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: そういう意味ではありません。地域で声をかけ、困っていることなどに気づくことを伝える内容です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-05.translation: It does not mean that. It is about speaking to one another in the neighborhood and noticing when someone has a problem, for example.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: では、相手を疑って問い詰める話として教えないようにします。短い説明を自分の言葉で書いて、教室で読みたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 説明を短く自分の言葉で教室用に書くと述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-06.translation: Then I will avoid teaching it as a matter of suspecting and interrogating others. I would like to write a short explanation in my own words and read it in class.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say you will write a short explanation in your own words for class. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 具体的に困った場面は、それぞれの状況を伺ってご相談に対応します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-07.translation: For specific difficult situations, we hear about each person's circumstances and provide consultation.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 教室には夜遅く帰る人もいます。この紙を読んだあと、不安に思っていることを質問にまとめてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 夜の帰宅に不安のある参加者の質問をまとめたいと話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-08.translation: Some people in the class go home late at night. After reading this paper, may we put together questions about their concerns?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say you want to collect questions from participants concerned about returning home at night. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 質問は、相談の際にお持ちください。緊急の連絡が必要な状況とは分けてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please bring your questions when you come for a consultation. Keep those separate from situations requiring emergency contact.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: はい。教室で読むだけで解決したことにはせず、相談したい人には、質問を持ってこちらへ来る方法を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 相談希望者に質問を持参する方法を伝えると述べる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-10.translation: Yes. I won't treat simply reading it in class as having resolved things. I will tell people who want a consultation how to come here with their questions.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say you will explain how people wanting a consultation can bring their questions. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: お知らせを読んでくださってありがとうございます。それでは、教室の皆さんにもよろしくお伝えください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-04-001-SHARED-11.translation: Thank you for reading the notice. Please give my regards to everyone in your class.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お送りになる物は、こちらの紙でしょうか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-01.translation: Is this sheet what you want to send?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 子供が描いた絵です。祖母に送りたいのですが、折り目をつけない包み方を考えています。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 子供の絵を折り目なしで送りたいと相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-02.translation: It is a picture my child drew. I want to send it to my grandmother, and I am thinking about how to package it without making creases.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask about sending your child's picture without creasing it. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 今お持ちの封筒には入りますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-03.translation: Will it fit in the envelope you have with you?

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 入りません。二つ折りなら入りますが、真ん中の顔に折り目がつくので、そのままにしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 現封筒では顔の部分が折れると説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-04.translation: No. It would fit folded in half, but that would crease the face in the middle, so I want to keep it flat.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain that the current envelope would require folding the face part. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 紙の大きさに合う包装をご用意ください。傷みにくいような保護も必要です。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-05.translation: Please prepare packaging that fits the paper's size. Protection to prevent damage is also necessary.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 家に薄い板があります。それにはさんで、絵より大きい封筒に入れる方法を考えてもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 板で保護し大きい封筒へ入れる案を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-06.translation: I have some thin boards at home. May I consider sandwiching the picture between them and putting it in an envelope larger than the picture?
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask about protecting it with boards and putting it in a larger envelope. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 包装した後の大きさや重さを見て、送れる方法をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-07.translation: We will look at the size and weight after packaging and explain the available mailing methods.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: では、今日はまだ出しません。板の角が封筒を破らないよう包んでから持ってきます。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 板の角を保護し包装後に再来局すると話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-08.translation: Then I won't send it today. I will wrap it so the boards' corners do not tear the envelope, and bring it back.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say that you will protect the board corners and return to the post office after packaging. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 宛先を書く場所も、外側に確保してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please also leave space on the outside to write the address.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。絵の裏へ住所を書こうと思っていましたが、外側に書きます。祖母へも、準備してから送ると連絡します。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 宛先を包装外側へ書き祖母に発送予定を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. I was going to write the address on the back of the picture, but I will write it on the outside. I will also tell my grandmother I will send it once it is ready.
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say that you will write the address on the outside of the packaging and tell your grandmother your mailing plan. Say it in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: ご用意できましたらお持ちください。それでは、またのご来局をお待ちしております。
DLG-SC-LOC-JP-21221-05-001-SHARED-11.translation: Please bring it in when it is ready. We look forward to your next visit to the post office.
